def transform(workbookNew, fontOld):
    fontNew = workbookNew.createFont()
    fontNew.setBoldweight(fontOld.boldweight)
    fontNew.setCharSet(fontOld.charset)
    fontNew.setColor(fontOld.color)
    fontNew.setFontName(fontOld.fontName)
    fontNew.setFontHeight(fontOld.fontHeight)
    fontNew.setItalic(fontOld.italic)
    fontNew.setStrikeout(fontOld.strikeout)
    fontNew.setTypeOffset(fontOld.typeOffset)
    fontNew.setUnderline(fontOld.underline)
    return fontNew

import math
import time

class Rect:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = self.y = self.width = self.height = 0

class Painter:
    def __init__(self, background):
        self.background = background
        self.rect = Rect()
        self.index = 0
        self.frameCount = 0
        self.totalTime = 0
        self.averageTime = 0
        self.RADIUS = 10
        self.FRAMES = 16

    def paintComponent(self, g, w, h):
        start = time.perf_counter_ns()
        g.drawImage(self.background, 0, 0, self)
        theta = 2 * math.pi * self.index / 64
        self.index += 1
        g.setColor("blue")
        self.rect.x = int(math.sin(theta) * w / 3 + w / 2 - self.RADIUS)
        self.rect.y = int(math.cos(theta) * h / 3 + h / 2 - self.RADIUS)
        self.rect.width = 2 * self.RADIUS
        self.rect.height = 2 * self.RADIUS
        g.fillOval(self.rect.x, self.rect.y, self.rect.width, self.rect.height)
        g.setColor("white")
        if self.frameCount == self.FRAMES:
            self.averageTime = self.totalTime // self.FRAMES
            self.totalTime = 0
            self.frameCount = 0
        else:
            self.totalTime += time.perf_counter_ns() - start
            self.frameCount += 1
        s = "%8.3f" % (self.averageTime / 1000000)
        g.drawString(s, 5, 16)

def to_hex_string(data):
    return "".join("%02x" % (b & 0xFF) for b in data)

def is_anagram(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) != len(s2):
        return False
    arr1 = sorted(s1)
    arr2 = sorted(s2)
    print("".join(arr1))
    print("".join(arr2))
    return arr1 == arr2
